title: Keep the contract
lesson: Preserve compatibility constraints across agent handoffs, reopen their source, and rerun the matching check before accepting a patch.
limitations: The invoice example is an illustrative scenario, not a recorded agent run or a measured failure rate.
A missing requirement may be rediscovered, and restoring context does not guarantee compliance.
The v1 fixture checks only its covered behavior; human review remains pending.
Written or persistent instructions do not enforce permissions; authorization is outside this lesson.
Audio was analyzed for peak, timing, and spectral events, but was not physically listened to.
This is an independently authored alternative; no comparative winner is claimed.

transcript.text: In this illustrative invoice task, the agent receives a goal to fix a timeout and a requirement to keep the v1 response field total_cents. A compatible patch passes the v1 fixture, establishing the normal case.
A handoff keeps the timeout goal but drops the compatibility requirement. The missing row turns red and empties. This shows one possible loss of context, not an inevitable result of summarization.
A second agent session uses the incomplete handoff and returns the replacement field amount. The same v1 fixture now fails, making the incompatible change visible.
The v1 contract is reopened. Its total_cents requirement is loaded back into the checked handoff. The fixture remains failed until the patch is repaired and checked again.

The agent reads the repaired handoff, restores total_cents in its patch, and reruns the fixture. It passes this check, while human review remains pending. The outcome is illustrative: context does not guarantee compliance or enforce permissions.
